   193→# ===================================================================
   194→# 3. Fuzzy matching
   195→# ===================================================================
   196→
   197→def fuzzy_match(query: str, text: str) -> float:
   198→    """Simple fuzzy matching. Returns score 0.0--1.0.
   199→
   200→    Algorithm:
   201→    - Empty query matches everything (1.0).
   202→    - Exact substring match (case-insensitive): 1.0.
   203→    - All query chars appear in order in text: fraction matched.
   204→    - All query words appear in text: 0.8.
   205→    - Otherwise 0.0.
   206→
   207→    Bonuses:
   208→    - Prefix match: +0.2
   209→    - Word boundary match: +0.1
   210→    """
   211→    if not query:
   212→        return 1.0
   213→
   214→    q = query.lower()
   215→    t = text.lower()
   216→
   217→    score = 0.0
   218→
   219→    # Exact substring match
   220→    if q in t:
   221→        score = 1.0
   222→    else:
   223→        # Subsequence match: all chars of query appear in order in text
   224→        qi = 0
   225→        for ch in t:
   226→            if qi < len(q) and ch == q[qi]:
   227→                qi += 1
   228→        if qi == len(q):
   229→            # Score based on how tight the match is (length ratio)
   230→            score = len(q) / len(t) if len(t) > 0 else 0.0
   231→        else:
   232→            # Word match: all space-separated query words appear in text
   233→            words = q.split()
   234→            if words and all(w in t for w in words):
   235→                score = 0.8
   236→            else:
   237→                return 0.0
   238→
   239→    # Bonus: prefix match
   240→    if t.startswith(q):
   241→        score = min(score + 0.2, 1.0)
   242→
   243→    # Bonus: word boundary match (query matches start of a word)
   244→    if re.search(rf'(?:^|[\s/\-_]){re.escape(q)}', t):
   245→        score = min(score + 0.1, 1.0)
   246→
   247→    return score

   251→# 4. Search function

   254→def search_palette(
   255→    query: str,
   256→    entries: Optional[list[PaletteEntry]] = None,
   257→    limit: int = 10,
   258→) -> list[PaletteEntry]:
   259→    """Search palette entries with fuzzy matching.
   260→
   261→    Returns the top *limit* results sorted by score descending.
   262→    Entries with score 0.0 are filtered out.
   263→    """
   264→    if entries is None:
   265→        entries = build_palette_entries()
   266→
   267→    results: list[PaletteEntry] = []
   268→    for entry in entries:
   269→        label_score = fuzzy_match(query, entry.label)
   270→        desc_score = fuzzy_match(query, entry.description)
   271→        best = max(label_score, desc_score)
   272→        if best > 0.0:
   273→            # Create a copy with the score set
   274→            results.append(PaletteEntry(
   275→                label=entry.label,
   276→                command=entry.command,
   277→                category=entry.category,
   278→                description=entry.description,
   279→                score=best,
   280→            ))
   281→
   282→    results.sort(key=lambda e: e.score, reverse=True)
   283→    return results[:limit]
